name: Girl Education Promotion (Bicycle Scheme)
benefit: - Each eligible girl student in class 9 receives ₹2,850/-. - The benefit includes a bicycle for plain areas and an FD (Fixed Deposit) worth ₹2,850/- for hilly areas.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a girl student studying in Class 9. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a government or government-aided non-government secondary school under the Uttarakhand Board.
